items.title: Redis Cloud on AWS simplifies production RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows
points: Redis Cloud combines caching and vector storage (a database that stores numerical representations of text for similarity search) in one managed platform, removing the need for two separate synced databases.
Integrates with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base to enable low-latency, contextually aware AI responses.
Deployment simplified to three steps: subscribe via AWS Marketplace (14-day free trial), create a vector index linked to Bedrock Knowledge Base, then connect it to a Bedrock agent for production use.
Reduces operational complexity and billing overhead by consolidating infrastructure and using AWS Marketplace billing.

issues.subject: ☕️ Build production-ready RAG workflows on AWS

headlines: Redis Cloud on AWS combines caching and vector storage in one managed platform, eliminating the need to run and sync two separate databases for production RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications.
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base integrates with Redis Cloud vector indexes to enable contextually aware AI responses with low-latency document retrieval.

RAG deployment simplified to three steps: subscribe to Redis Cloud via AWS Marketplace, create a vector index connected to Bedrock Knowledge Base, and associate with a Bedrock agent for production use.

sections.title: The RAG Infrastructure Problem and Solution
points: 1. Most production RAG applications require running two separate databases: a cache system for speed and a vector store (a database that stores numerical representations of text for similarity search) for retrieval, plus custom code to keep them synchronized.
2. Redis Cloud consolidates both caching and vector storage into a single managed platform, reducing operational complexity from managing two systems to one.

3. The unified approach integrates directly with AWS services (Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base and agents), simplifies billing through AWS Marketplace, and eliminates the 2am debugging scenarios caused by database desynchronization.

sections.title: Step-by-Step RAG Agent Implementation
points: 1. Subscribe to Redis Cloud through AWS Marketplace and activate the 14-day free trial with billing remaining on your existing AWS account.

2. Create a vector index in Redis Cloud and configure it as the vector store backend for an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base, which automatically ingests documents and stores their embeddings (numerical representations of document meaning).
3. Link the Knowledge Base to an Amazon Bedrock agent to enable contextually aware responses powered by low-latency vector search retrieval from Redis.
